'''Chris Carman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[August 2001 Williston Park tournament]] on 18 August 2001 with Senate mains, according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2865">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-williston-park-ny-8-18-01-epiosde-1d2865/ williston-park-ny-8-18-01-epiosde-1], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-williston-park-ny-8-18-01-epiosde-1d2865/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
